findings.title: Missing key prop on GrafanaRuleListItem in list
findings.body: The rewrite of the 'grafana' branch in FilterView drops `key={key}` from the rendered `GrafanaRuleListItem`. These items are rendered in a list that grows as more pages load. Without a stable key, React logs warnings and falls back to index-based reconciliation, so component state and hooks can attach to the wrong rule as rules are appended.

findings.title: Pause and Delete menu items never render in list view
findings.body: The list view now passes only `promRule` to the menu, so `rulerRule` is undefined. Even when `canPause` or `canDelete` comes out true from the prom-based abilities, the render conditions still require `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` (Pause, line 123) and `rulerRule` (Delete, line 165). As a result, users can no longer pause or delete Grafana rules from the alert list.

findings.title: Silence drawer never opens for prom-only rules
findings.body: The Silence menu item is shown based on the prom abilities. However, the drawer only renders when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. In the list view `rule` is undefined, so clicking 'Silence notifications' does nothing.

findings.title: Export ability excludes Grafana recording rules
findings.body: `ModifyExport` uses `isAlertingRule`, whereas the ruler version uses `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule`, which covers any Grafana rule including recording rules. Pause and Restore have the same narrowing. This silently drops these actions for Grafana recording rules in the list view.

findings.title: View link lost returnTo parameter
findings.body: The rule link previously included `returnTo` via `createReturnTo()`; the new href omits it. As a result, navigation back from the rule view to the filtered list no longer preserves the user's position and filters.
